pendingReview.title: Man given 15‑month probation order for filming male bather in Morse Park shower
pendingReview.description: 6th November 2026 - (Hong Kong) A 31‑year‑old accounting employee who hid a mobile phone in a bag beneath a shower‑stall door to record a man washing in the male changing room at Morse Park (Park No. 3) in Wong Tai Sin was on Friday placed on a 15‑month probation order. Acting Principal Magistrate Cheng Lim‑chi at Kowloon City Magistrates' Courts accepted a probation officer's assessment that supervision was appropriate and said the court would "give one chance" in light of the report's findings. The defendant, named in court as Lau Chun‑fai, admitted one count of voyeurism over the incident on 26th July 2026. The court heard that the victim noticed a bag pushed under the cubicle door and, suspecting wrongdoing, inspected it to find a phone actively recording with its camera pointed towards him. He stopped the recording, confronted the defendant outside the stall and, upon request, obtained the phone's passcode. A 2‑minute‑36‑second clip was found showing the defendant's face at the outset, panning across the changing and shower areas and capturing the victim nude before ending as the victim picked up the bag. The victim forwarded the footage to his own device and deleted it from the defendant's phone, with a friend witnessing the exchange, and the matter was then reported to police. In mitigation, the defence said the defendant had recently lost his job and acted on impulse. He later underwent a rapid urine test on 29th October that returned negative for drugs and enrolled in a community drug‑rehabilitation programme. The bench stressed that voyeurism typically attracts immediate custody and that the same sentencing principles apply regardless of the genders involved. Having considered the probation report and the circumstances, the court imposed a 15‑month probation order under supervision.

The victim immediately terminated the recording, stepped outside to confront Lau, and demanded the passcode to unlock the handset.
